essence: The five-limb ritual admits both separate and collective modes of application.
The five-limb procedure is mapped onto the heart, hands, navel, and feet.
The present applications of the five-syllable formula must be understood as previously taught.
This is the colophon of the thirty-first chapter of the Meru Tantra.
Accomplishment may be granted by tamasic, rajasic, and sattvic agents.
